headline: North Georgia go into conference play unbeaten
dek: North Georgia have won four and drawn one, conceding two goals along the way. They open conference play at home to Lander with every other programme bar Flagler already beaten at least once.
displaced_by: North Georgia beat AUM: an eighth scorer and a second goal conceded, so the standing seven-scorers, one-conceded lines are no longer true

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: North Georgia's eleven goals are more than USC Aiken and Lander have scored between them, and eight different players have shared them.

wire.line: Flagler have drawn all three of their matches and are still unbeaten.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their date with no published result, among them Clayton State's visit to Oglethorpe and Middle Georgia State's to Columbia on 22 August.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Kalle Kuisma has made ten saves for Clayton State and has conceded twice.

next_match.line: Lander arrive off their first win of the season; North Georgia have yet to lose.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
